title: Reindexing restricted decision tree depth
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb N$, let $e$ be a bijection from the $m$ coordinates to the $n$ coordinates, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $m$, and assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of three statuses: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The decision tree depth of the restriction of the reindexed function using these statuses equals the decision tree depth of the restriction of $f$ using, at coordinate $i$, the status assigned to $e(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: bijection e between the coordinate sets
Boolean function on the m-dimensional sign cube
coordinate restriction assignment on the n coordinates
